checks.observation: The current PDF independently measures 12/13/14 pt text; panel headings, legends, units and tick labels are legible in the newly viewed render.

checks.name: palette_and_redundant_encoding
checks.observation: Gray solid analytical reference, orange dashed Euler and blue dotted RK4 stay consistent across panels and do not rely on color alone.

checks.name: complementary_panel_roles
checks.observation: The upper panel shows shared-input trajectories, while the lower panel makes their absolute errors visible against the analytical reference.

checks.name: comparable_geometry_and_explicit_scales
checks.observation: Time ranges and horizontal plot extents match. Remaining fraction and absolute error have separately labeled vertical scales.

checks.name: bounded_scientific_presentation
checks.observation: Synthetic is visible in the figure. The current caption explicitly distinguishes deterministic solver errors from confidence intervals.
